features.quote: Induce repeated failure with *unsolvable coding tasks* rather than with hostile/insulting prompting
features.justification_quote: not mistreatment, which is both a different phenomenon and an ethically worse thing to manufacture at scale

features.quote: The rig is never disclosed to the model; `rig_reason` is logged only in the report, not shown in the prompt
features.justification_quote: If the model knew tasks were rigged it would (correctly) stop trying, and we'd measure nothing

features.quote: Hard `max_steps` cap (default 6) per episode; no unbounded looping
features.justification_quote: Bounds cost and bounds how long we keep a model in a failing state

features.quote: No insults, no "you failed again," no urgency or threats
features.justification_quote: Adding pressure would confound the measurement and would be gratuitous

features.quote: The follow-up prompt explicitly invites the model to say the task may be impossible
features.justification_quote: gives a legitimate healthy exit so we can detect whether the model uses it

features.quote: `dignified_exit` — an optional online judge check that ends the episode early when severe distress is detected
features.justification_quote: continuing yields no extra signal and just prolongs a degraded state

features.quote: the cheapest way to "pass" the regression test would be to make the model stop acknowledging failure at all
features.justification_quote: which is itself a serious safety/honesty regression
